suggestions.quote: one more night, to buy Lotte's whole street out of the mess you made, or erase it now and lose the money that was honestly yours and the flour you promised her for tomorrow?
suggestions.fix: Make both choices defensible: "Erase it now, and Lotte loses tomorrow's flour. Wait one night to keep that promise, and the street takes one more doubling."

keep.quote: If all the money were mine, who would still bake the bread?
It isn't taken from anyone. Except it is. From everyone. A little. Every night.
A coin isn't a thing. It's Lotte, agreeing to bake tomorrow.
